findings.desc: decision_doc_save scope guard can be bypassed conceptually because it accepts current checklist file declarations after the scope contract fails. checklist_update permits files updates in DEV, while decision_doc_save is also DEV-only, so a DEV actor can add docs/requirements/decisions/<slug>.md to checklist files and then save without a PLAN-frozen scope contract or accepted scope extension. This violates the product boundary that save must not become a back door for expanding story scope during DEV.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by removing checklist file declarations from decision_doc_save scope authorization; save now accepts only scope-contract allowedCreate/allowedModify or accepted/approved scope extension. Verified by decision-doc-promotion smoke checklist-only scope backdoor blocked and accepted scope extension authorizes outside-contract target.

findings.desc: CHK-001 adversarial / CHK-004 adversarial require preview to be read-only for story metadata, process events, and project docs, but the smoke only snapshots decision-doc-proposals.json and the target doc around decision_doc_preview. It does not snapshot process-events.jsonl or store.readProcessEvents before/after preview, so a regression that appends a decision_doc_preview process event would still pass. Evidence: packages/main/src/tasks/decision-doc-promotion-smoke.ts:226-233 checks proposal metadata and target absence only; handler path under review is packages/main/src/handlers/decision-doc-promotion.ts:410-423.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by adding preview read-only assertions for raw process-events.jsonl and store.readProcessEvents before/after decision_doc_preview, in addition to proposal metadata and target doc checks. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run test:decision-doc-promotion-smoke.

findings.desc: CHK-003 happy evidence says `node packages/main/dist/cli.js help | rg "decision_doc_(proposal|preview|save)|decision doc (proposal|preview|save)"` lists decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_preview, and decision_doc_save, but in the B-acec REVIEW worktree that exact check only lists decision_doc_preview because printHelp filters active-story commands by current phase. Command-specific --help and the process fact contract do cover schema/registry, but the recorded help-list evidence is not reproducible for this story context. Evidence: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:2515-2517 filters help by phase; observed output in this review matched only decision_doc_preview.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed evidence path by adding phase-independent command-specific help smoke for decision_doc_proposal --help, decision_doc_preview --help, and decision_doc_save --help instead of relying on phase-filtered global help. Verified by decision-doc-promotion smoke and process fact contract.

findings.desc: Runtime F-001 is fixed, but the durable requirements plan still describes checklist/file declarations as a valid decision_doc_save authorization source. docs/requirements/decisions/decision-doc-promotion-execution-plan.md lines 266-268 say the save target may be covered by scope contract, allowed file declarations, or an accepted scope extension, and lines 397-399 say PLAN scope, checklist file declarations, or accepted scope extension. The handler now correctly has no checklist fallback and authorizes only scope-contract allowedCreate/allowedModify or accepted/approved scope extension, so the doc should be updated to avoid re-teaching the DEV scope backdoor.
findings.resolvedReason: Docs updated to remove the checklist/file-declaration authorization fallback. decision_doc_save is now documented as authorized only by story scope contract allowedCreate/allowedModify or an accepted/approved scope extension, matching the runtime gate.

findings.desc: The durable execution plan still contains stale authorization wording at several locations: prior PLAN scope coverage, declared PLAN scope, target paths outside PLAN scope, and accepted scope extension only. That conflicts with the required contract that decision_doc_save authorization comes only from scope contract allowedCreate/allowedModify or an accepted/approved scope extension, with no checklist/file declaration fallback.
findings.resolvedReason: Docs updated across the durable execution plan: save authorization now consistently requires scope contract allowedCreate/allowedModify coverage or a mechanically valid accepted/approved scope extension. Targeted search found no stale PLAN scope, declared scope, checklist/file declaration fallback, or plain accepted-extension authorization wording in the save path.

findings.desc: decision_doc_save accepts accepted/approved scope-extension proposals by status and patch.allowed only, without validating the scope-extension proposal/decision hashes. The smoke currently constructs an accepted extension with dummy _hash values and save succeeds, so a tampered scope-extension-proposals.json can authorize a decision-doc write outside the scope contract.
findings.resolvedReason: decision_doc_save now validates accepted/approved scope-extension proposals with existing scope anti-expansion digest helpers before path matching can authorize an outside-contract target: story id, proposal status, decision status, decision _hash, and proposal _hash must all be fresh. Smoke now refuses forged dummy _hash extensions and accepts a helper-built signed extension.
